title: Chapter 334 The Vast Divine Empire
content:
Chapter 334 The Vast Divine Empire

In the back hall, Zhao Bangde frowned and said with a serious face: "How do you know the four words, the Great Wall of Steel?"

Wang Shuo found an excuse, saying that he heard it by chance from the Undead Warrior.

Zhao Bangde pondered for a long time, and then slowly said: "The Great Wall of Steel is a section of the Great Wall located in the north of Dahuai Domain, with a length of more than 500 kilometers,..."

Zhao Bangde told Wang Shuo all the information he knew about the Great Wall of Steel.

Some time ago, Zhao Bangde went to check it out in person. At that time, he was also shocked by the grandeur of the Great Wall, but he didn't know the function of this Great Wall.

The towering Great Wall is full of ancient and desolate feelings. Even from a distance, you can feel a sense of killing.

The entire Great Wall is shrouded by an invisible barrier and cannot be approached.

It seems that outside the Great Wall, there is something extremely cruel to guard against.

For a while, both of them fell into deep thought.

"It seems that the progress of the next stage must be related to this Great Wall." Zhao Bangde held his cheek and said solemnly.

Wang Shuo also nodded.

In any case, to defend such a long section of the wall, a large number of people are needed. It seems that a sufficient population must be retained.

To rescue Nanxuan Prefecture and Fenglin County, action must be taken as soon as possible.

Then, Wang Shuo asked about the situation of the Shenwu Empire.

"I have heard of this Shenwu Empire in my early years. Its territory is extremely vast, with many races, and even allows transformed monsters to serve as city lords. The internal forces are complicated."

"Then do you know where it is?"

Zhao Bangde laughed, stood up, and said: "Of course it is outside the domain. We are in the Dahuai Domain and will not have any intersection with it in a short time."

Wang Shuo wanted to blurt out: "The Shenwu Empire is to our north. Maybe the Great Wall of Steel is used to guard against the Shenwu Empire."

But these are just Wang Shuo's guesses, and he didn't say it in the end.

Back to the Chiyan Army tent.

Wang Shuo opened the "Shenwu Empire Overview".

It introduces the history, region, and some major forces of the Shenwu Empire in detail.

After reading it, Wang Shuo took a breath of cold air.

It turned out that the area of the Shenwu Empire was hundreds of millions of square kilometers.

The Shenwu Empire nominally ruled this vast territory.

Within the empire, countless kingdoms, principalities, federations and other subordinate countries were divided.

These countries are also constantly fighting each other, all wanting to gain more territory.

In the southernmost part, that is, north of the Great Wall of Steel, it is ruled by several city lords.

These city lords were also born from the new game area of Dahuai Domain.

The entire border of the Shenwu Empire is this new area.

When the time comes, it will be connected to the territory of the entire Shenwu Empire.

By then, those old kingdoms, principalities, city lords, and lords will quickly annex the new areas like wolves.

The closer to the Shenwu Empire, the higher the level of development, and they will pose a serious threat to the outside world.

One layer threatens another layer, and one layer devours another layer.

Wang Shuo now has a preliminary understanding of what kind of situation he will face.

Presumably, those elites from outside the domain were the city lords on the other side of the Great Wall who stuffed them in!

Wang Shuo felt a sense of powerlessness.

There was the disaster of the undead nearby, and the threat of the foreign lords in the distance.

When will it end!

Could it be the day when the Shenwu Empire is overthrown?

Wang Shuo then smiled calmly, he really dared to think so!
